_comment: Example calibration. One entry per approach, named by the leg traffic
arrives from. Replace every number with values measured at your site:
these are illustrative and will produce confident nonsense if copied.
stop_line_polygon: image pixels, the detection zone for this approach.
homography: 3x3 image-to-road matrix. [x, y, w] = H . [u, v, 1], and
the road point is (x/w, y/w) in metres, y along the approach.
zone_area_m2: road-plane area of the polygon, used for occupancy.
